lines.text: Many learners say: I am in the bus now.
Better: I am on the bus now.
On! She is on the train.

native.caption: Ты тоже говоришь “I am in the bus now”? 😅 По-русски «в автобусе» — с «в», и хочется сказать “in”, но про автобус по-английски говорят “on.” Правильно: “I am on the bus now.” Послушай Карлоса и повтори! Больше практики — в приложении Lexkite.

en.hook: In the bus or on the bus?
en.tip: For a bus, use “on”: “I am on the bus now.”
en.caption: Do you also say “I am in the bus now”? 😅 In Russian «в» leads to “in”, but for a bus English says “on.” Correct: “I am on the bus now.” Listen to Carlos and repeat! Practice more in the Lexkite app.
